verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a persistent browser-sessions feature that keeps cookies, storage, tabs and state across operations, with pause and VNC takeover. It also offers SDK/REST access to cloud Chromium instances, which implies programmatic session handling. Nothing in the evidence mentions running sessions concurrently or any documented concurrency limits. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/quotas, evidence of running a fleet of parallel sessions, explicit session create/list/close API documentation, independent corroboration at scale.
